brief: A 3D-printed motor mount plate in PLA. The base plate is 60 mm long, 40 mm wide and 6 mm thick. A cylindrical boss 18 mm in diameter and 25 mm tall stands in the middle of the plate, with a 2 mm fillet where the boss meets the plate. An 8 mm shaft bore runs all the way through the boss and the plate, on the boss axis. Four 4.5 mm mounting holes pass all the way through the plate on a 44 mm by 24 mm rectangular pattern centred on the plate. The finished part must stand no taller than 32 mm and weigh no more than 30 g. It carries no structural load - it is a printed fixture, so there is no load case.
